en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large stone statue on a high pedestal in a park or garden. The statue depicts a seated figure (Lord Byron) with a female allegorical figure embracing him from behind. There are trees and low fences in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom in English and Greek, and a web watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is visible across the lower-right portion of the image.
